card.name: Space before large quantity figures
card.fires_on: The space just before a number, after words like about, nearly, over or encompassing. The number is a large statistic with units such as million hectares, billion tons, acres or km.

modes.label: Estimate before big number
modes.description: A space after about, approximately, or over, right before a large figure with a unit.
